exercises.title: Employees with their department name
exercises.problemHtml:
tblEmployee only stores the department number. Show every employee together with the name of their department.

FUHCompany schema (the course's sample database — full script in the FUHCompany.sql tab)
TableColumns (PK underlined, FK in italics)
tblEmployeeempSSN DECIMAL(18,0), empName NVARCHAR(50), empAddress NVARCHAR(100), empSalary DECIMAL(10,0), empSex CHAR(1) (F/M), empBirthdate DATE, depNum → tblDepartment, supervisorSSN → tblEmployee
tblDepartmentdepNum INT, depName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE, mgrSSN → tblEmployee, mgrAssDate DATE
tblProjectproNum INT, proName NVARCHAR(50), locNum → tblLocation, depNum → tblDepartment
tblWorksOnempSSN, proNum, workHours DECIMAL(5,1)
tblLocationlocNum INT, locName NVARCHAR(50) UNIQUE
tblDepLocationdepNum, locNum
tblDependentempSSN, depName NVARCHAR(50), depSex CHAR(1), depBirthdate DATE, depRelationship NVARCHAR(30)

14 employees, 5 departments, 6 projects, 16 work assignments, 5 dependents. Names are Vietnamese with diacritics; text compares case-insensitively as on SQL Server.

Requirements

  • Columns: empSSN, empName, depName.
  • Employees without a department (none in the sample data) may be left out.
  • Row order does not matter.

-- Written in SQL Server syntax, like the PE's DBscript.sql — runs as-is in SSMS.
CREATE TABLE tblLocation (
    locNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    locName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_location      PRIMARY KEY (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_location_name UNIQUE (locName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepartment (
    depNum      INT            NOT NULL,
    depName     NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    mgrSSN      DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    mgrAssDate  DATE           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_department      PRIMARY KEY (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_department_name UNIQUE (depName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblEmployee (
    empSSN         DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    empName        NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empAddress     NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
    empSalary      DECIMAL(10,0)  NULL,
    empSex         CHAR(1)        NULL,
    empBirthdate   DATE           NULL,
    depNum         INT            NULL,
    supervisorSSN  DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_employee            PRIMARY KEY (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_sex        CHECK (empSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_salary     CHECK (empSalary > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum)        REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_supervisor FOREIGN KEY (supervisorSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepLocation (
    depNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    locNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_deplocation            PRIMARY KEY (depNum, locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblProject (
    proNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    proName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    locNum   INT           NULL,
    depNum   INT           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_project            PRIMARY KEY (proNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblWorksOn (
    empSSN     DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    proNum     INT            NOT NULL,
    workHours  DECIMAL(5,1)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_workson          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, proNum),
    CONSTRAINT ck_workson_hours    CHECK (workHours >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_project  FOREIGN KEY (proNum) REFERENCES tblProject (proNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDependent (
    depName          NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empSSN           DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    depSex           CHAR(1)        NULL,
    depBirthdate     DATE           NULL,
    depRelationship  NVARCHAR(30)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_dependent          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, depName),
    CONSTRAINT ck_dependent_sex      CHECK (depSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT fk_dependent_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

ALTER TABLE tblDepartment
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_department_manager FOREIGN KEY (mgrSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN);

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: An anti-join keeps rows of A that have no match in B. Two portable forms: LEFT JOIN + IS NULL on a NOT NULL column of B (here the key), or WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM B WHERE …).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Anti-join giữ các dòng của A không có cặp ở B. Hai cách viết chạy mọi hệ: LEFT JOIN + IS NULL trên một cột NOT NULL của B (ở đây là khoá), hoặc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM B WHERE …).

solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT l.locNum, l.locName, p.proName
FROM tblLocation l
LEFT JOIN tblProject p
       ON p.locNum = l.locNum
      AND p.depNum = 1;   -- the filter belongs to the JOIN: it decides which projects can pair up
-- Putting "WHERE p.depNum = 1" would throw away the NULL-extended rows and turn the outer join into an inner join.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: For outer joins, ON decides which rows pair up; WHERE then filters the result. Conditions on the optional (right) side belong in ON. This is one of the most common PE mistakes.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Với outer join, ON quyết định dòng nào ghép cặp; WHERE lọc kết quả sau đó. Điều kiện trên phía tuỳ chọn (bên phải) đặt ở ON. Đây là lỗi rất hay gặp trong PE.

CREATE TABLE tblLocation (
    locNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    locName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_location      PRIMARY KEY (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_location_name UNIQUE (locName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepartment (
    depNum      INT            NOT NULL,
    depName     NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    mgrSSN      DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    mgrAssDate  DATE           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_department      PRIMARY KEY (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT uq_department_name UNIQUE (depName)
);

CREATE TABLE tblEmployee (
    empSSN         DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    empName        NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empAddress     NVARCHAR(100)  NULL,
    empSalary      DECIMAL(10,0)  NULL,
    empSex         CHAR(1)        NULL,
    empBirthdate   DATE           NULL,
    depNum         INT            NULL,
    supervisorSSN  DECIMAL(18,0)  NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_employee            PRIMARY KEY (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_sex        CHECK (empSex IN ('F', 'M')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_employee_salary     CHECK (empSalary > 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum)        REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_employee_supervisor FOREIGN KEY (supervisorSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDepLocation (
    depNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    locNum  INT  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_deplocation            PRIMARY KEY (depNum, locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_deplocation_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblProject (
    proNum   INT           NOT NULL,
    proName  NVARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    locNum   INT           NULL,
    depNum   INT           NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_project            PRIMARY KEY (proNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_location   FOREIGN KEY (locNum) REFERENCES tblLocation (locNum),
    CONSTRAINT fk_project_department FOREIGN KEY (depNum) REFERENCES tblDepartment (depNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblWorksOn (
    empSSN     DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    proNum     INT            NOT NULL,
    workHours  DECIMAL(5,1)   NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_workson          PRIMARY KEY (empSSN, proNum),
    CONSTRAINT ck_workson_hours    CHECK (workHours >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_employee FOREIGN KEY (empSSN) REFERENCES tblEmployee (empSSN),
    CONSTRAINT fk_workson_project  FOREIGN KEY (proNum) REFERENCES tblProject (proNum)
);

CREATE TABLE tblDependent (
    depName          NVARCHAR(50)   NOT NULL,
    empSSN           DECIMAL(18,0)  NOT NULL,
    depSex           CHAR(1)        NULL,
    depBirthdate     DATE           NULL,
